correctness.rationale: Writing a unit vector uniquely as u(1,a), adjacency between slope classes is exactly b=-a^{-1}. The fixed slopes are the solutions of a^2=-1, giving one in characteristic two, two when q is odd and congruent to one modulo four, and none when q is congruent to three modulo four. Hence the graph is precisely the published clique/biclique disjoint union. On K_m, paired-dominating sets are exactly positive even subsets; on K_{m,m}, they are exactly equal positive selections from the two sides. Multiplication over components gives the formula. Fresh independent coefficient calculations reproduced the minimum degrees and leading-degree reconstruction across q=3,4,5,7,8,9,11. The analytic component argument proves all prime powers.
